content:
The notice board is at (2,7), 0 tiles away — I'm on it. It blocks. 

This is a soft-lock where I spawned on the notice board. But wait — the task says "stand next to the workbench and press KeyC". The workbench is at (10,5). I need to get there. But I can't move at all.

Let me reconsider: maybe the notice board is a solid object and I'm NOT actually on it — maybe the coordinate system has me at (2,7) but the board is a large object whose collision extends. The fact that ALL 4 directions are blocked strongly suggests I'm enclosed.

Let me try pressing E to read the notice — perhaps the game has a special "read notice" that works when standing on/at the board. Let me try facing down and E, then up and E, in case the board is at (2,8) or (2,6) in collision terms.

Actually, I already tried all 4 with E. All "nothing-there".

Let me try a longer wait — maybe the notice board is a scheduled thing that gets removed. Or maybe I should try moving with a very long single hold in one direction to "push through".
